source_batch.unit_label: BRBL B U07: Creation/Registration and Satisfaction of Charges — Separate creation, filing, permitted late registration and chargeholder application

facts.locator: printed pp.216–218; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware distinguishes initial registration, historical/newer late-filing regimes, certificates and chargeholder applications. Form/fee labels require reconciliation against current rules.

Section 77 has an initial 30-day registration duty and conditional late-registration provisos distinguishing creation regimes. For the stated later regime, the text describes 60 days from creation and then a further 60 days on application and prescribed fees, not automatic approval or a 300-day route for every charge. Section 78 provides the qualified chargeholder application route and fee recovery.

payload.title: Creation, submission and registration are different events
payload.core_explanation_md:
Keep the signed instrument, creation facts, application, actual registration and certificate as distinct evidence. The file must identify the company, chargeholder, secured assets and scope of the charge, with the prescribed particulars and instrument where applicable. Submitting a form does not by itself prove that the Registrar registered the charge or issued its certificate.

For the duty under section 77, the text starts with thirty days from creation. Late-registration routes are conditional and version-specific. A bank should diarise the applicable filing obligation and retain the actual result rather than assume an application receipt completes every security requirement. This draft is not a filing calendar for a live transaction.

self_check.prompt_text: What evidence is still needed after an application receipt?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The actual registration result and certificate, with the applicable legal and filing requirements.

payload.title: Do not add every extension to every new charge
payload.core_explanation_md:
The inspected section 77 provisos distinguish charges by their creation regime. Its later-charge route describes a period measured from creation and a further conditional period, with application and prescribed fees. It does not give an automatic extension or make the older three-hundred-day route available to every new charge.

The courseware own tables distinguish historical regimes, while its earlier unit contains a broader summary. Use the controlling provision and rules applicable at the exam cutoff, not whichever summary offers more time. The retained Act is consolidated after cutoff, so exact form versions, fees, transitional conditions and calendar treatment require independent verification before release.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a conditional late-registration route amount to automatic acceptance of a late filing?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable regime, application, fee and other conditions still matter.

payload.title: The chargeholder has a separate statutory application route
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section 78 addresses the specified company failure to register and permits an application by the person in whose favour the charge was created. The Registrar process includes the company opportunity stated in the provision. The chargeholder route is therefore different from pretending that the company filed on time.

Where registration is effected on that application, the section permits the stated fees or additional fees to be recovered from the company. Record who applied, under which provision, the notices and actual outcome. Do not infer either that only the company can ever initiate registration or that the chargeholder can bypass every condition.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should the file record who made the registration application?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The chargeholder statutory route has its own trigger, process and fee-recovery consequences.

payload.stem_md: A file treats the section 77 later-charge late-registration route as automatic permission to wait, without application or prescribed fees. Which distinction is missing?

options.text_md: The initial duty and the conditional, creation-regime-specific late-registration route
options.explanation_md: The provisos do not remove the initial duty or create automatic late acceptance.

options.text_md: Every charge always has the historical three-hundred-day route
options.explanation_md: The text distinguishes creation regimes and conditions rather than supplying that universal route.

options.text_md: The certificate exists as soon as the security instrument is signed
options.explanation_md: Execution does not itself establish registration and certificate issue.

options.text_md: No chargeholder can ever apply when the company fails
options.explanation_md: Section 78 provides a qualified chargeholder application route.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The provisos do not remove the initial duty or create automatic late acceptance.

payload.stem_md: A company has failed to register in the circumstances covered by section 78. The lender says it has no possible application route because it is the chargeholder. What should it examine?

options.text_md: Whether a private account entry can replace the Registrar process
options.explanation_md: An internal entry does not complete the statutory registration process.

options.text_md: Whether all company defaults extinguish the security agreement immediately
options.explanation_md: The provision addresses a registration route rather than such universal extinguishment.

options.text_md: The section 78 chargeholder application, company-notice process and fee-recovery rule
options.explanation_md: The statute expressly recognises this qualified route.

options.text_md: Whether the facility interest rate alone permits bypassing every filing condition
options.explanation_md: Pricing cannot replace statutory procedure.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statute expressly recognises this qualified route.

payload.stem_md: An application receipt is placed in the security file and marked as conclusive evidence that the registration certificate has been issued. What is the evidence error?

options.text_md: The receipt proves that the underlying debt is never repayable
options.explanation_md: A filing receipt does not determine repayment liability.

options.text_md: A certificate cannot ever follow a chargeholder application
options.explanation_md: The statute provides a chargeholder route subject to its conditions.

options.text_md: The company registered office alone proves certificate issue
options.explanation_md: An address does not evidence the Registrar decision.

options.text_md: Submission and completed registration/certificate issue have been conflated
options.explanation_md: These are distinct events and the actual result must be retained.

payload.correct_explanation_md: These are distinct events and the actual result must be retained.
